audit_metadata.title: End-to-End Continuum Evidence Propagation & Blind-Cohort Leakage Audit

verdict_justification.summary: End-to-end evidence propagation from external catalog measurements to FUSION-X candidate records is fully functional, strictly score-invariant, and provenance-preserving within the declared P0008 scope. No calibration parameter leakage exists (baselines use static literature loci and frozen calibration assets). However, a governance enforcement gap was audited in EmpiricalContinuumSidecar: when external photometry is attached for blind-cohort sources (P0002/P0009/P0010), BLIND_COHORT_UNVERIFIED_BASELINE is appended as metadata but does not enforce a programmatic fail-closed block against color_excess_detected=True. Controlled remediation is documented and recommended.

calibration_blind_leakage_audit.gap_description: BLIND_COHORT_UNVERIFIED_BASELINE is attached as metadata disclosure only when external photometry is provided; it does not programmatically override color_excess_detected to False in EmpiricalContinuumSidecar.evaluate_continuum.
